schema_addition.placement: tail of FoundationProject.properties after ai_engineering_data; purely additive (verified: every pre-existing property deepEqual-unchanged, required/rls byte-identical)

design_basis.code_edition: string — locally adopted edition ('ASCE 7-16', 'OBC 2019'...). String not enum: adopted editions can be old/obscure and an enum would fail closed on legitimate values
design_basis.code_edition_prior: string — superseded edition preserved on post-capture change (the no-silent-change trail)
design_basis.jurisdiction: string — free-text adopted-code locality; future PermitLocality/JurisdictionProfile link may refine, never replace
design_basis.basis_notes: string — local amendments / ordinance refs / partial adoptions (CMP-I02 keeps adopted amendments distinct from referenced standards)
design_basis.basis_source: enum [manual, official_report, api] — api reserved (no current writer); authored content edits re-mark 'manual' unless official_report explicitly selected this write
design_basis.basis_captured_at: string ISO-8601 — FIRST capture, immutable thereafter
design_basis.basis_updated_at: string ISO-8601 — most recent authored basis edit
design_basis.basis_locked: boolean — operator lock; gated edits require recorded re-capture confirmation; stripped when nothing is captured

site_hazard.latitude: number, nullable, -90..90 enforced at the write model — null = recorded-but-unset, absent = never captured, never 0-filled
site_hazard.units: enum [imperial, metric] — absent = unstated, never assumed
site_hazard.input_timestamp: string ISO-8601 — most recent authored change

schema_addition.edition_single_source: the adopted standard edition lives ONCE in design_basis.code_edition; site_hazard deliberately does not duplicate it (two edition fields could diverge silently — the exact failure O-104 forbids)

write_model_semantics: candidates/foundationDesignBasis.js — sanitizeDesignBasisWrite(current, fields, {now, confirmed}) and sanitizeSiteHazardWrite(current, fields, {now}) return {next|undefined, changed, issues[]}. Empty-string fields strip keys (explicit-empty vs authored); coords accept explicit null (schema-declared nullable); out-of-enum/out-of-range values are rejected from the record with an issue and the prior value kept; provenance (basis_source/entry_method) lands 'manual' on authored writes, honors explicit official_report, and can never produce 'api'; basis_updated_at/input_timestamp stamp only on real changes (an identical re-write returns changed:false — no timestamp churn, no dirty-marking); basis_captured_at is first-capture immutable; a post-capture code_edition change (including clearing it) preserves the superseded value in code_edition_prior; a fully cleared block reduces to next:undefined so the editor stores null (explicit clear, not a ghost audit shell); a locked basis rejects content edits AND unlocking until confirmed:true.
panel_behavior: FoundationDesignBasisPanel renders inside FoundationRatesPanel below the rates card, same {project, onChange} patch contract. code_edition commits whole-value on blur/Enter (per-keystroke writes would pollute code_edition_prior with mid-typing fragments); jurisdiction/basis_notes/exposure_assumption commit live; selects show '— not recorded —' for unset and strip on clear; CoordInputs keep an in-focus draft so negatives/partials type freely (empty commits explicit null, finite numbers commit live); the source select defaults the SESSION to 'manual' so any edit re-marks a captured basis manual unless official_report is explicitly re-picked this session ('api' is never offered); a locked basis disables all basis inputs behind a 'Change basis…' confirm that records the re-capture intent (armed state and both source selections are scoped to project.id so nothing leaks across a project switch); status lines display captured/updated timestamps, source, prior edition, and recorded-input timestamp/entry-method.

carry_path_audit.in_memory: normalizeFoundationAssembly does const next = { ...project } (foundationAssemblyModel.js:259) — both blocks survive commit() normalization, undo/redo history, and calc memos verbatim
carry_path_audit.PERSISTENCE_REMAINDER_BLOCKER: payload() (src/pages/FoundationEstimator.jsx ~line 649) is a strict field allowlist consumed by updateBuilderSourceProject -> staffEntityWrite updateMany {id, updated_date} {$set}. It does NOT carry design_basis/site_hazard, so panel edits round-trip in-memory but are DROPPED ON SAVE until the estimator-page owner adds two lines: `design_basis: project.design_basis,` and `site_hazard: project.site_hazard,` to payload(). FoundationEstimator.jsx is outside this unit's ownership — this is the flagged integration remainder. Side-writing from the panel was rejected: a $set outside the page's CAS bumps updated_date and forces 'changed in another session' conflicts on the user's next save.
carry_path_audit.draft_recovery_remainder: FOUNDATION_DRAFT_FIELDS (foundationDraftRecovery.js:3) is also an allowlist — basis/hazard edits are not covered by the unsent browser-draft backup until the recovery owner adds both keys (recovery files not owned).
carry_path_audit.save_as_copy: handleSaveAsCopy builds baseData from payload() + identity fields — new blocks do not copy. DELIBERATE: a copy is a new project and must re-confirm its own basis rather than silently inherit the source project's capture (O-104). Revisit only as an explicit user choice.
carry_path_audit.template_travel: FOUNDATION_TEMPLATE_FIELDS (foundationTemplateModel.js:37) does not carry them — DELIBERATE non-carry, matching the pricing_engine exclusion precedent: a template is a reusable design while a basis is site/project-specific; transplanting another site's adopted edition/jurisdiction would be exactly the silent equating O-104 bans. A future apply-time 'also copy site inputs' checkbox would be an authored choice, not a carry.

no_silent_change_guarantees: nothing auto-fills: absent stays absent, no edition/units/category is ever suggested as a value (the datalist offers text suggestions only, committed by the user)
the newest-published-is-adopted conflation is blocked by copy: UI text states 'locally adopted — never the newest published edition'
every basis write stamps basis_source + basis_updated_at; captured_at is immutable; edition changes preserve code_edition_prior
basis_locked makes post-capture edits impossible without an explicit recorded re-capture intent
no other writer exists: only the panel writes these fields, and only through the page's own commit path
